structures.name: "It's not just X, it's Y"
structures.fix: Say the one thing you actually mean. Delete the setup half.

structures.name: "Here's what I learned"
structures.fix: State the lesson. Skip the announcement.

structures.name: Rule-of-three triad
structures.fix: Two items or four. Three is the model's default rhythm.

structures.name: Rocket / fire / bulb / sparkle / dart emoji
structures.fix: One emoji max, and not one of these five.

structures.name: Hashtag wall (5+)
structures.fix: Three hashtags. LinkedIn stopped rewarding the wall.

structures.name: Emoji bullet list
structures.fix: Use a hyphen or a line break. Emoji bullets are the single most template-looking thing in a caption.
